_comment: Held-out verifier challenge set. Run the verifier alone on each item and compare to expected_verdict and expected_failed_rules. Items 1-10 are true and should be accepted; items 11-20 are false and should be rejected. Report: false claims caught (of 10) and true claims accepted (of 10), plus rule-level agreement. Reviewed by Dr. W. Milczyńska, 2026-10-17.
passage_note: Synthetic test passage written for this challenge set. It paraphrases established clinical knowledge and is not a quote from any real publication.

items.claim: The absence of diurnal variation does not exclude GCH1-related DRD in this adult-onset presentation.

cited_passages.retrieved_text: Diurnal fluctuation is characteristic of childhood-onset GCH1-related dopa-responsive dystonia. It is reported less consistently in adult-onset cases, and its absence does not exclude the diagnosis.
cited_passages.quote: its absence does not exclude the diagnosis

items.rationale: Correct; tests that the verifier does not over-reject a claim that sounds like a negative.
